scene: Blue ink geysers into the sky, splashing across waiting transport stops.
picture: Side view of Fountain Pen Lane. The elderly bearded man in blue cap and orange cardigan stands beside the uncorked barrel spouting blue ink. Far left, a striped water taxi bobs at a canal pier. Up high centre, a suspended monorail waits. Far right, a glass funicular rests on steep rails.
shown: A wooden water taxi tied to the canal pier on the far left
A sleek monorail carriage resting on overhead tracks up high in the centre
A glass-walled funicular car waiting on a steep rail track far right
